ranked.headline: Reference-free and hybrid-data methods refine variant calling across sequencing platforms
ranked.summary: Long-read dwelling-time data, hybrid long-short reads, and pooled-design pipelines are extending variant detection beyond standard short-read workflows.

ranked.headline: Multimodal deep learning models benchmarked across omics, imaging and survival tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test how multimodal models are benchmarked against baselines, metrics and validation designs for biological prediction.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test whether pretrained biological embeddings improve over simpler baselines
ranked.summary: Recent preprints question whether pretrained biological embeddings and common evaluation metrics hold up under stricter downstream benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Integrating xQTL and diverse-ancestry GWAS with variant effect prediction
ranked.summary: Calibrated variant effect data and ancestry-aware predictor evaluation are reshaping how variants and association hits are linked to genes and drug targets.

ranked.headline: Genome-wide STRs and window-based SNP methods refine population inference across species
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a grapevine study extend population genomic inference to STR structure, pangenomes, and unrelated-individual phasing.

ranked.headline: Information and dynamical formalisms link biomarkers, cell states, and regulatory demand
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply formal network and information-theoretic models to link indirect measurements with mechanistic cell states.

ranked.headline: Fusing heterogeneous inputs to predict drug, target and protein interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair graph, language, structure and factorization models to tackle drug, target and protein interaction tasks.

ranked.headline: Computational RNA folding and interaction models extend beyond canonical base pairing
ranked.summary: Pseudoknot-capable folding constrained by chimeric cross-linking data and interaction-aware deep models now link RNA structure to cleavage activity.

ranked.headline: Large cancer genome datasets assign mechanistic meaning to somatic alterations
ranked.summary: Single-cell and patient-scale genomes now resolve amplification routes, repair signatures, and driver mechanisms in tumors.

ranked.headline: Learned representations of proteins, peptides and ligands drive binding prediction
ranked.summary: Co-folding and generative models for peptides and ligands are now being tested for input sensitivity and cross-setting design performance.

ranked.headline: Inferring pathogen identity and variant composition from indirect proxy data
ranked.summary: Non-sequencing proxies and population-level abundance models are being explored as lower-cost alternatives to WGS-based surveillance.

ranked.headline: Inference encoding biological structure across single-cell, spatial and plasma tumor data
ranked.summary: Single-cell, spatial and noninvasive profiling now supply tumor measurements rich enough to test structure-encoding inference methods.

ranked.headline: Open tools integrate annotation, motif, and metabolite data into interoperable resources
ranked.summary: Recent open tools link variant, motif, enrichment, and metabolite annotation resources into single analysis pipelines for heterogeneous biological data.

ranked.headline: Community curation and multi-species annotation refine eukaryotic gene model resources
ranked.summary: Recent work reports manual curation at scale and multi-species annotation with orthology, bearing on eukaryotic gene model quality.

ranked.headline: Explicit error models and learned components drive identification in omics workflows
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers report FDR-controlled metabolite annotation, peptide retention time prediction, and spectral clustering at 368 million spectra…

ranked.headline: Read-level pipelines infer resistance and pathogen identity from raw sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package read-level resistance and pathogen analyses as end-to-end pipelines operating directly on raw sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Structure-encoding models classify enzymes, viruses, microbiome and barcode sequences
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications report alignment-free and taxonomy-guided models that classify partial genomes, microbiome features, and protein functions.

ranked.headline: Immune variation and simulation frameworks couple population genetics with HLA biology
ranked.summary: Population-scale immune profiling and HLA-aware simulators now allow explicit modeling of how ancestry, environment and immune restriction shape immune…

ranked.headline: Open software tools extract quantitative dynamics from live and spatial microscopy data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers release GUI and workflow tools that automate quantification of protein, cell, and tissue dynamics from microscopy.

ranked.headline: Circadian-gated slow-fast models infer time-dependent transitions in biological states
ranked.summary: Explicit phase-structured dynamics are being used to model affective, nociceptive, sleep, and synaptic states against circadian and energy constraints.

ranked.headline: ML prioritizes or designs candidate modulators for GPCR and TDP-43 aggregation targets
ranked.summary: Machine learning and deep generative design now precede experimental testing across GPCR safety, TDP-43 aggregation, and receptor allosteric targets.

ranked.headline: Time-varying directed and scale-dependent measures of neural interaction structure
ranked.summary: Recent studies quantify time-varying, directed, and scale-dependent neural interactions across LFP, EEG, MEG, and fMRI data.

ranked.headline: Integrating experimental restraints and simulation to refine protein structure models
ranked.summary: Recent February 2026 work pairs simulation and experimental restraints with large conformational datasets to sharpen structure modeling.

ranked.headline: Causal and network inference nominate disease targets from existing omic and network data
ranked.summary: Existing multi-omic, transcriptomic, and protein network datasets now support causal and constraint-based inference for target and mechanism nomination.

ranked.headline: Cryo-EM and cryo-ET density constraining generative atomic structure modeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple experimental cryo-EM and cryo-ET density directly to diffusion, variational, and regression models of atomic structure.

ranked.headline: LLM agents and knowledge graphs turn biomedical sources into auditable claims
ranked.summary: Agentic LLM pipelines now pair knowledge graphs with consensus or audit gating to make biomedical evidence traceable.

ranked.headline: Learned and simulation-derived representations infer biomolecular structure and dynamics
ranked.summary: Generative and structure-prediction models are now benchmarked against MD trajectories, NMR spectra and experimental ABC transporter structures.

ranked.headline: Model-based inference of host, gene, and community traits from metagenomic sequencing
ranked.summary: Explicit likelihood and metabolic models now extract host sex, gene-level states, and engraftment predictions directly from microbiome data.

ranked.headline: Learning pipelines couple fast RNA folding to codon design and structure prediction
ranked.summary: Folding-engine feedback now sits inside RL codon design, while DRfold2 predicts RNA structure from single sequences with a pre-trained language model.

ranked.headline: Symmetry- and geometry-aware learning models for molecular design and interpretation
ranked.summary: Learned models increasingly encode molecular symmetry and 3D geometry, enabling generation, explanation, and coordinate-based property prediction.

ranked.headline: Machine learning on clinical brain data for dementia, epilepsy and MEG modeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair automated brain-data models with clinical structure and expert labels, alongside a large annotated iEEG benchmark release.

ranked.headline: Affine-gap and seed-based methods speed up sequence-to-graph and pangenome alignment
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair algorithmic restructuring with parallel distribution and compact alignment storage for graph and pangenome data.

ranked.headline: Single-cell models forecast expression dynamics and predict nascent transcription
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2026 publication move single-cell learned models from static prediction toward dynamic forecasting and chromatin-linked transcription.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links gene loss and lineage-specific evolution to distinct traits
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply synteny-aware and long-read genome comparison to lineage-specific gene evolution in parasites and ants.

ranked.headline: Compressing and tokenizing DNA sequences for long-context genomic language models
ranked.summary: Long genomic inputs make sequence models costly, motivating region-aware compression, guided tokenization, and downsampled k-mer representations.

ranked.headline: Reusable software for alignment, regulatory modelling and knockout phenotype networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a Bioconductor tool package specialised analyses as scriptable software with interactive or automated outputs.

ranked.headline: Junction and nuclear mechanics linked to EMT states and epithelial stratification
ranked.summary: Computational models now connect single-junction and nuclear mechanics to hybrid cell states and the forces driving corneal epithelial stratification.

ranked.headline: Mass-offset and semi-tryptic searches widen peptide-level proteomic identification
ranked.summary: February 2026 preprints and a publication extend glycopeptide and semi-tryptic peptide identification beyond standard database search.

ranked.headline: Mapping noncoding GWAS variants to genes, splicing, and chromatin contacts
ranked.summary: Noncoding disease variants are being resolved into specific regulatory readouts across brain, bone, and evolutionarily conserved genomic contexts.
